Folder: /BP/TS-109 Box Module - Resources - Resource Grid
Labels: be-enterprise, can_be_automated

Steps:

   Data: boxName:
TC-2895 Box Module - Resources - Resource Grid - Filtering by name / Multiselect in Individual/Team view

2. Click on filter button in the left header, expand ‘Teams,’ and click on ‘Select team’ dropdown menu

* Unknown
* Team Unassigned 
* 2895 Team A  
* 2895 Team B  
* 2895 Team C  
* 2895 Team D

2895 Team D

* Unassigned
* TC-2895 User 2 
* TC-2895 User 3 
* TC-2895 User 4

2895 Team C
